differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the yellow Recurly tile, creating a tight framing.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further back, resulting in a wider framing with more surrounding tiles visible.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and focal length to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: The background tiles are out of focus due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background tiles remain sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust focus distance and aperture.

differences.a_observable: The frame edges show a distinct vignette with darker corners.
differences.b_observable: The frame edges are evenly lit with no vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette in post-processing or adjust camera lens shading.

differences.a_observable: The yellow tile has a warm, highly saturated golden color.
differences.b_observable: The yellow tile is cooler and less saturated.
differences.fix: Adjust the material color of the yellow tile to increase saturation and warmth.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera position and focal length to match the reference framing and enable depth of field to replicate the shallow focus look.
